summary: The `ansible.builtin.local` connection plugin runs tasks on the Ansible controller instead of a remote host, ignoring the remote user and using the user who ran the CLI.
questions: How do I run tasks on the control node itself?
Which user runs tasks with the local connection?
Does remote_user matter with connection: local?

answer_card.title: ansible.builtin.local connection plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.local` executes tasks on the Ansible controller rather than a remote host. The remote user is **ignored**; tasks run as the user who executed the ansible CLI.
